messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-8472 fired for embeddings-prod-eu
incidentbot: Severity: high — 5xx spike detected (rate ~ 12% over baseline), alerting owner rotation.
olivia: ack — I'm taking first look. joining bridge: https://redwood.incidents/bridge/8472
kevin: oncall? I see increased 503 from aligner pods. Any initial remediation steps?
olivia: checking logs now, running curl against /v1/embeddings - getting 503s, tailing ingress and pod logs.
sara: heads up, a customer reported increased latency for search in EU, ticket #EU-421. Possible impact to a few PLG accounts.
miguel: if it's KV cache saturation we can scale dedicated pool, but need confirm. I'll shadow traffic to a new pool if olivia wants handoff.
olivia: tentative hypothesis: kvcache eviction + overload on param servers. Can someone run: kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embedder -o wide
kevin: ran quick check, 3/6 embedder replicas OOMKilled recently, restart loop on node eu-2.
oncall-rota: stepping in as primary. I'm escalating to infra to cycle eu-2 node. @infra-team 
olivia: thanks. miguel — can you take ownership of scaling/rollout so I can focus on root cause and logs?
miguel: taking ownership of scale/rollout. will provision two extra t4p pools and route low-priority traffic.
miguel: command run: deploy-scale --cluster eu --pool embedder --replicas +2
sara: I'll update customer ticket and mention we're mitigating, ETA 15–30m. noting affected customers: SmallShop, AcmeSearch.
kevin: adding diagnostic: sample log snippet
kevin: ```
2026-03-17T14:20:11Z embedder-1 ERROR "KV cache miss and OOM" mem=11.2GB
```
olivia: I'll keep watching error rate. ping us when infra confirms node recycle. :thumbsup:
oncall-rota: infra confirmed node eu-2 cordoned and draining, will reboot in 3m.
miguel: scale completed, new replicas up, routing rules adjusted. monitoring token: https://metrics/redwood/embeds?range=15m
olivia: error rate dropping from 12% -> 1.8% over last 5m. continuing observation. If stable in 10m, we'll mark mitigated.
sara: customer update posted. thanks team. :raised_hands: 
oncall-rota: official PD status: acknowledged -> claimed by miguel (rotation handoff). handback plan: if regress within 30m, re-escalate to oncall infra.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-8472 status updated: acknowledged by miguel at 1769643225
olivia: plan for follow-up: incident follow-up doc + root cause analysis. assigning postmortem owner: olivia.
miguel: noted. I'll hand off final status in 20m once we've had stable window.
